text: SelfCheckGPT leverages the simple idea that if an LLM has knowledge of a given concept, sampled responses are likely to be similar and contain consistent facts.
However, for hallucinated facts, stochastically sampled responses are likely to diverge and contradict one another.

However, uncertainty metrics such as token probability or entropy require access to token-level probability distributions, information which may not be available to users for example when systems are accessed through limited external APIs.
